lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Indonesia, representing approximately 41.7 million structures. Data quality is assessed through AI-mapped estimates indicating 56% coverage of total buildings, with average data age of 3 years and 1% recent updates. Exports are provided in multiple GIS-compatible formats (GeoJSON, KML, GeoPackage).
